column1: # hippocampal_pathways.tsv — CA1 afferent topology, distilled from the
# Bezaire, Raikov, Burk, Vyas & Soltesz (2016) eLife 5:e18566 full-scale
# syndata_120 (the model's own defaults in setupfiles/parameters.hoc).
# nconv   presynaptic cells contacting one postsynaptic cell
# nsyn    synapses per such connection;  ntotal = nconv * nsyn
# region  section list to draw from;  dlo/dhi  path-distance window (um) from soma
# w       peak conductance per synapse (uS);  tau1/tau2 rise/decay (ms);  erev (mV)
# A blank/zero nconv means the model defines the synapse but makes no connection.
